why_best: This sequence establishes dramatic editorial weight, holds kinetic energy during the read, and delivers instant punch without distracting motion.
why_bad: Animating a wipe or stroke across the text pulls focus toward the mechanics of the reveal rather than landing the statement with immediate authority.
trap: A near-miss will mistakenly wipe the accent color left-to-right across the passage instead of shifting the entire highlighted region all at once.
